summary: Ranks member completions from recent code and comment words.
limitations: Trained on one repository with a narrower member list than the compiler offers. Extension methods are not ranked. It learns word associations from comments, not their meaning. Scores are relative, not confidence.

provenance.corpus: WpfStudio's own C# source, mined with Roslyn, plus name-derived comment hints on 25% of training examples. No Microsoft model weights or predictions.

evaluation: 2,012 held-out examples from 50 files of the training repository: top-1 42.10%, top-5 79.87%, MRR@5 0.5610.
